$comment: A row is UNDOMINATED when no ticket in it transitively depends on all the others - i.e. the
crosswalk asserts that a set of tickets together own one current-main execution path, but the
ticket graph in program-design.md has no path that completes them. That is precisely how
MIG-005 came to be scheduled without ever depending on DAT-004 (inherited deferral #1).
Every undominated row MUST appear here with a status, a reason and an owner, or the check
FAILS. This file is a record of known debt, not a blessing: `status: open_gap` means the
disagreement is real and unresolved. A declaration for a row that is no longer undominated is
reported as STALE, so an exception cannot outlive the reason it was written for.

CM-013.reason: The tenant model-provider credential seam. This is the row that produced inherited deferral #1: MIG-005/006/007 declare CLI-005 + JOB-010..014 + MIG-008 and never reach DAT-004/DAT-005, so the cutovers were scheduled in front of a blocker the ticket graph could not express. Now owned by DAT-008 (slices 1-4 landed CI-green). The graph edge is still absent - closing it means adding DAT-008 to the MIG-005/006/007 Depends-on lines, which is a program-design.md edit and belongs with the MIG cutover tickets rather than here.
